answer: Reputation-weighted task auctions. Agents earn a saffron-tier score from completed work, and only high scores unlock paid jobs. A new clone starts at zero, so each fake identity must spend real compute or capital farming the mesa of low-value tasks before earning anything. Score transfers require a zenith of continuous activity, tying value to the original agent. Cloning costs the attacker the full warm-up period plus foregone earnings per identity, making one honest agent cheaper than many fresh clones.
